QF.id: XXVA Sales and Distribution of Research Services_4

question.text: The three key steps in the writing process of a research report are:

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook's report-writing discussion identifies three important steps in compiling research reports: Planning (structuring sections and assigning deadlines), Drafting (working on each section), and Editing (rechecking the draft for financial figures, spellings, and grammar). The Trap: While research, analysis, and distribution form part of the broader research process, the writing-specific steps described in the workbook are plan-draft-edit. Note: Based on workbook pages 247-249 on the research-report writing process.
